scenarios.name: low-devotion-not-a-creature
scenarios.why: Devotion to red counts red mana symbols among seat 0's permanents: Purphoros alone is 1, below five, so it is not a creature.

scenarios.name: devotion-five-is-a-6-5-creature
scenarios.why: Purphoros ({R}) plus four one-{R} permanents is devotion 5: the condition is false, so it is a 6/5 creature.

scenarios.name: another-creature-enters-deals-two
scenarios.why: The trigger works whether or not Purphoros is a creature: another creature entering under seat 0's control deals 2 damage to each opponent.
